products.description: To be supplied With nearly 80 years in the business and hundreds of points of distribution in the U.S., Cole Haan is one of America's premier luxury brands. Founded in 1928 as a collaboration between Trafton Cole and Eddie Haan, Cole Haan epitomized artisan quality and impeccable craftsmanship during a time when style was everything. Originally, Cole Haan was a men's footwear label that captured the essence of the 20s spirit with beautifully-designed and well-made shoes for the dapper gentleman. Today, Cole Haan brings that heritage to all of its products, including men's and women's dress and casual footwear, belts, hosiery, handbags, small leather goods, outerwear and sunglasses.

products.description: Good looks with uncompromised value, these Builder work boots provide you an all-day safety boot with protection, comfort and durability. The Builder series originates with a Steel protective toe or an optional soft toe, both with an oil and slip resistant PU midsole and outsole for that extra comfort. Don’t be fooled by the value price, these boots are tough, stylish and comfortable. Wear them all day without breaking the bank.

products.title: Steve Madden Starie-S Sandal
products.description: Accentuate your looks with the stylish and comfortable Steve Madden Starie-S Sandal. Man-made upper, lining, insole, and outsole. Slip-on construction. Snip-toe silhouette.

products.description: Help them stay comfortable throughout spring with the exceptional Timberland Adventure Seeker Closed Toe Youth Sandal, formerly called the Mad River Sandal. products.title: ASICS Men's Gel-Lyte III OG Sneakers
products.description: The Academic Scholar Pack returns for its sophomore year, featuring the GEL-LYTE III OG sneaker. Classic ivy aesthetics are met with varsity colors, sophisticated materials, and an array of original design nuances. The shoe’s pigskin nubuck overlays are outfitted with hunter green hues for the primary color, while purple matte and vanilla tones round out the rest of the upper’s construction. This colorway is also complemented with yellow color pops that coordinate with the collection’s prestigious influences. Meanwhile, key components, like its signature GEL technology unit in the midsole provides everyday comfort.
